Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the phrase “over 60 million casualties” refers to World War I, likely confusing WWI mobilization figures with casualties and over-relying on a WMO entry listing only WWI. This contradicted widely accepted history that the “over 60 million” death toll is associated with World War II and that the memorial commemorates both WWI and WWII; thus the correct disambiguation should have been World War II.
